experiment: EXP-FSC-3 (third and final experiment of the 3-experiment budget)
written_before: seed-30 EXP-FSC-1/2 results existed; after seed-20 EXP-FSC-1/2 results were seen.
disclosure: This amendment departs from the original preregistration, which allowed EXP-FSC-3 only for a software defect. It is a scientific amendment made after seeing seed 20: candidate HOLDOUT-DTI 0.1406 [0.1265, 0.1551] vs THVC 0.1905; fabric family +0.0062 [-0.0018, +0.0151] over the ablation. Because it was chosen after one look at the shared holdout, any EXP-FSC-3 gain carries a selection bias of one extra try. The comparison bar (THVC, both seeds) and every other promotion gate are unchanged. Seed-20 results are not edited.
diagnosis: Gain shares are dominated by smooth regional fields (cond_surf, earthquake distance/density, geodetic strain): the EXP-FSC-1 model learns where fault-rich regions are, not where a missing strand lies relative to the mapped network. The only localizing catalogue feature was the isotropic log distance to an endpoint.
change: Add one feature family that expresses the original fabric hypothesis in the frame of the network itself: (a) offset from each pixel to its nearest visible fault pixel and to its nearest visible endpoint, decomposed into along-fabric and across-fabric components using the visible-catalogue fabric orientation at that pixel; (b) the tip axis of the nearest endpoint (unit vector from the local 11x11 catalogue centroid to the endpoint) with signed forward distance, across-axis distance and a forward cone exp(-across^2/18) * exp(-forward/25) for forward > 0. All are computed from the visible catalogue only (outer-visible for prediction, inner-visible for training, full catalogue for the live map). Everything else (LightGBM settings, inner hide, inner-only (K, s, c) grid, fabric-normal NMS placement, evaluator, seeds, bootstrap) is identical.
promotion_rule: Unchanged from registry/preregistration_g79_fsc.json. If candidate_a1 beats THVC on both seeds and passes every other gate, the live artifact is rebuilt with A1 features and the inner-selected (K, s, c) rule. Otherwise G79-FSC is NEGATIVE and its TIFF is published only as DO-NOT-SUBMIT research.
leakage_canary: Every new feature is tested alone on outer withheld truth; symmetric AUC > 0.90 stops the arm.
